text_block_list.text:
She finished the Tenno Sho (Spring) 
without incident. However, with no time to 
celebrate, the two rush to the hospital 
for an examination.

The result—no abnormalities found. As 
expected, it won't disappear due to 
injury. The important part is how to 
overcome what comes next.

While the Takarazuka Kinen suits her 
aptitude, she bypasses it. By choosing a 
different target from that other universe, 
she ensures her escape from tragedy.

The new goal is the Tenno Sho (Autumn). To 
make it through the summer and reach 
autumn, a way had to be found to protect 
Neo Universe.
